Scaffold-default CSS is therefore a class with no detector, so the only route to finding the remainder is another human read of the file, which is exactly how it surfaced (an audit row, not a build). (3) #app's box properties do not move the app, because its only top-level children .bg-layer and .game-stage are position: fixed; inset: 0 (App.svelte:2561-2565, App.svelte:2219-2227, recorded at app.css:136-142), but text-align: center is an INHERITED property and inheritance follows the DOM tree irrespective of positioning, so the scaffold's centring cascades into the whole component tree.
